title: 第七章 承惠一百两第八章 天山雪莲子
slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: 一个盐帮弟子踢开了医馆大门，持刀冲了进来。
他左右环顾一圈，“人呢？”
噗！
一根淬了毒的银针，从他的左耳穿过，右耳飞出。
啪嗒。
长刀落地，第一个进来的盐帮弟子倒地，嘴角流出殷红的鲜血。
“陈二，发生什么事了？”
毫无回应。
领头的盐帮弟子带着人进来，然后，他们便听见了破空声。
一根银针接着一根银针飞来，刚刚练功几年的盐帮弟子，根本躲闪不及，不过片刻便倒了一地。
看着地上倒着的七个盐帮弟子，李水生无奈摇摇头。
“我当我的医师，干嘛来招惹我呢？”
“唉，我这人，平生最不爱打打杀杀了，非要逼我出手。”
他如今虽然只有六十年功力，但也不是寻常帮众能奈何的。
便是葛教头，也未必挡得住圆满级别的太素银针，更别说这些小虾米了。
除非二流高手亲自出手，其他人根本拿不下他。
看着满屋子血迹，他叹一口气，摸索着他们身上的银子。
“才二十两？”
“也是，他们有银子，怎么会来干这么危险的活？”
银针上带着红白之物，看得李水生一阵作呕。
身为一个医师，他见过不少死人。
可亲手杀人，还要清理人体残渣，还是让他胃海翻腾。
就在李水生收拾之时，葛教头带着袁堂主从水寨赶了过来。
葛教头抓起一个武馆弟子，“那些盐帮的杂碎去哪儿了？”
“他们去李大夫的医馆了！”
葛教头面色一黑，“糟了，李大夫手无缚鸡之力，这次肯定遭殃了！”
袁堂主道：“快走，说不定还有得救！”
可当他们来到医馆之前时，却是惊诧不已。
“好浓的血腥味。”
袁堂主和葛教头对视一眼，都变得慎重起来。
他们走进医馆，便看到了那躺了一地的尸首。
再看在旁边收拾的李水生，顿时了然。
众多武馆弟子，看向李水生之时，眼里已经有了恐惧之色。
content_en:
A disciple of the Salt Gang kicked open the door of the medical center and rushed in with a knife.
He looked around, "Where are the people?"
Poof!
A silver needle tempered with poison passed through his left ear and flew out from his right ear.
Snap.
The long knife fell to the ground, and the first Yan Gang disciple who came in fell to the ground, with red blood flowing from the corner of his mouth.
"Chen Er, what happened?"
No response.
The leading Salt Gang disciple came in with people, and then they heard the sound of breaking through the air.
Silver needles flew one after another. The disciples of the Salt Gang, who had just practiced martial arts for a few years, were unable to dodge and fell to the ground within a moment.
Looking at the seven Salt Gang disciples lying on the ground, Li Shuisheng shook his head helplessly.
"I am my doctor, why are you messing with me?"
"Oh, I don't like fighting and killing the most in my life. You have to force me to take action."
Although he only has sixty years of skill now, he is not something ordinary gangsters can do.
Even Coach Ge may not be able to stop the Perfect Level Taisu Silver Needle, let alone these little shrimps.
Unless the second-rate master takes action himself, no one else can defeat him.
Seeing the blood all over the room, he sighed and fumbled for the silver on their bodies.
"Only twenty taels?"
"Yes, they have money, why would they do such dangerous work?"
There was something red and white on the silver needle, which made Li Shuisheng feel nauseous.
As a doctor, he has seen many dead people.
But killing someone with his own hands and cleaning up the remains of a human body still made his stomach churn.
"Ugh..."
While Li Shuisheng was cleaning up, Coach Ge and Hall Master Yuan rushed over from the water village.
Instructor Ge grabbed a martial arts disciple and asked, "Where are those bastards from the Salt Gang?"
"They went to Dr. Li's hospital!"
Instructor Ge's face darkened, "Oh no, Doctor Li is powerless, he will definitely suffer disaster this time!"
Hall Master Yuan said: "Let's go quickly, maybe we can still be saved!"
But when they arrived in front of the medical center, they were shocked.
"What a strong smell of blood."
Hall Master Yuan and Coach Ge looked at each other and became cautious.
They walked into the hospital and saw the body lying on the ground.
Looking at Li Shuisheng who was cleaning up next to him, he suddenly understood.
Many martial arts disciples already had fear in their eyes when they looked at Li Shuisheng.
